To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the Xcp system is a complex of 11 proteins that assemble into a multicomponent complex, (ii) the exoprotein is first recognized in the periplasm by the XcpQ protein, (iii) the energy requirement is provided by the proton motive force, (iv) the XcpB and XcpC proteins form an outer membrane pore that is used as the exit channel for the translocating exoprotein.
the Pseudomonas Xcp system is the best characterized GSP in Gram-negative bacteria, and is a paradigm for the GSP-dependent protein secretion.
(1) the Xcp machinery is a complex of three essential proteins, namely XcpR, XcpQ and XcpA, and two accessory proteins, XcpS and XcpT.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the molecular mechanisms of the Xcp system, with the ultimate aim of controlling its activity for therapeutic purposes.
the mechanisms by which proteins are exported from bacteria, with the aim to understand the general export pathway (the GSP).
the molecular mechanisms of secretion in bacteria and the role of secretion in the virulence of pathogenic bacteria.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Xcp machinery is a complex molecular machine that has to be assembled and activated to function.
the GSP is an efficient and reliable mechanism for protein secretion in Gram-negative bacteria.
the GSP is an energy-dependent process involving a complex and sophisticated machinery, which is able to translocate a large variety of exoproteins across the cell envelope.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Xcp system is a complex and versatile machinery that has evolved to allow the secretion of a wide variety of exoproteins.
the GSP machinery is a sophisticated molecular assembly able to recognize and to transport exoproteins of diverse sizes and properties.
the Xcp machinery has a modular structure and a complex assembly, that the GSP is a highly regulated system, and that exoprotein secretion is a highly efficient process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MTB of the GSP is a highly efficient and versatile secretion system.
the Xcp system is a highly versatile secretion pathway.
, in spite of the complexity of the GSP machinery and the multiplicity of the steps involved in the secretion process, the GSP is highly versatile.
